card.name: Completing set phrases like Space.com
card.fires_on: The closing piece of a familiar phrase: ".com" after Space, "etal" in Embryo-Fetal, "iatric" in geriatric. Also an opening parenthesis for a date after "today".

modes.label: Medical word endings
modes.description: Final piece of a split medical term such as geriatric or Embryo-Fetal.
modes.example: Embryo-F<<etal>> Toxicity: Can cause fetal harm.

modes.label: Space.com source name
modes.description: The ".com" after Space when naming the news outlet in a quote attribution.

modes.label: Date parenthesis in news
modes.description: An opening parenthesis for a date right after "released today" in a news story.
